g.text: Landsat 4/5/7/8/9 Collection-2 · Time Series Transformer with contrastive pretraining · 30 m · 1987–2025 · Dominant Tree Species DTS · Leaf Type Cover LTC
surface reflectance · 30 m · Planetary Computer STAC
6 SR bands + 8 spectral indices (NDVI, NIRv, NDMI,
EVI, WDRVI, NBR, NDWI, GNDVI) per observation
QA-Pixel cloud / shadow / snow mask → padding mask
3-year pooling: t−2, t−1, t · ~80–120 scenes per year
20 % spatial hold-out (10 × 10 km grid / site clusters)
3 years pooled → sorted → padded to 200 time steps
robust standardisation (q0.1 / q0.9), frozen at inference
+ sensor-platform embedding (L4 / L5 / L7 / L8 / L9)
× N blocks — no interpolation to a regular time grid
collapses time into one summary vector per target
per pixel and year: p(DTS) ∈ ℝ¹¹ and cover fractions ∈ [0,1]³
trained separately for the DTS and the LTC task
positive pair = same plot, two random 3-year windows
augment: temporal mask ≤ 20 % · noise σ = 0.01 · band mask 10 %
60 epochs · batch 128 · AdamW · cosine LR + 10 % warm-up
embedding layer frozen → contrastive features preserved
task heads retrained at reduced learning rate, 10 epochs
adapts the model to the full 40-year archive
additional fine-tuning passes from the Stage-2 checkpoint
→ anchors post-2020 predictions to field observations
inter-seed standard deviation per target and pixel
no temporal smoothing applied — left to the data user
Validated on VPO, VDBI and CFI hold-outs and historical
